verses.text: Israel’s people set out from Elim and reached the Wilderness of Sin, between Elim and Sinai. It was the fifteenth day of the second month since they left Egypt. 🏜️
The whole Israelite community started grumbling against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness. 😠
They said, ‘We wish Yahweh had let us die in Egypt! Back there we sat by cooking pots and ate all the bread we wanted. You brought us out here to starve this whole crowd to death!’ 😣
Yahweh told Moses, ‘I’m going to rain bread from the sky for you. Every day the people will go out and gather enough for that day. I’ll test whether they follow my instructions. 🍞
‘On the sixth day, they’ll gather twice as much and prepare it.’ 🧺
Moses and Aaron told all the Israelites, ‘By evening, you’ll know Yahweh brought you out of Egypt. 🌆
‘In the morning, you’ll see Yahweh’s glory, because he heard you grumbling against him. Who are we, that you grumble against us?’ 🌅

Moses said, ‘This evening Yahweh will give you meat, and in the morning he’ll give you all the bread you want. Yahweh heard you grumbling against him. Who are we? You’re grumbling against Yahweh, not us.’ 🗣️
Moses told Aaron, ‘Tell the whole Israelite community, “Come close to Yahweh—he heard your complaints.”’ 🙏
As Aaron spoke to the community, they looked toward the wilderness, and Yahweh’s glory appeared in the cloud. ☁️
Yahweh told Moses: 📣
‘I heard Israel’s complaints. Tell them: “This evening you’ll eat meat, and in the morning you’ll have all the bread you want. Then you’ll know I am Yahweh your God.”’ 🍽️
That evening, quail covered the camp. In the morning, dew lay all around it. 🐦
When the dew dried up, a small, round substance lay on the wilderness ground, fine as frost. ❄️
When the Israelites saw it, they asked each other, ‘What is this?’ They didn’t know what it was. Moses told them, ‘This is the bread Yahweh has given you to eat. 🍞
‘Here’s Yahweh’s instruction: everyone should gather what they need to eat—one omer per person, according to how many people are in each tent.’ 🧺
Israel’s people did so. Some gathered more, and some gathered less. ⚖️
When they measured it by the omer, the ones who gathered a lot had nothing left over, and the ones who gathered a little still had enough. Each person gathered what they needed to eat. 🤝
Moses told them, ‘Don’t leave any of it until morning.’ 🌅
But some people didn’t listen to Moses. They left some until morning, and it bred worms and stank. Moses was angry with them. 🐛
Every morning they gathered what they needed. When the sun got hot, the rest melted. ☀️
On the sixth day they gathered twice as much—two omers per person. All the community’s leaders came and reported it to Moses. 🧺
Moses said, ‘Yahweh told us: “Tomorrow is a day of complete rest, a holy Sabbath to Yahweh. Bake what you want to bake and boil what you want to boil. Save whatever is left for the morning.”’ 🕊️
They saved it until morning, just as Moses ordered. It didn’t stink, and no worms got into it. ✅
Moses said, ‘Eat it today. Today is Yahweh’s Sabbath. You won’t find any of it in the fields today. 🍞
‘Gather it for six days, but the seventh day is Sabbath. There won’t be any then.’ 📅
On the seventh day, some people still went out to gather, but they found nothing. 🚫
Yahweh said to Moses, ‘How long will you refuse to keep my commands and instructions? ⚠️
‘Look, Yahweh gave you the Sabbath. That’s why on the sixth day he gives you bread for two days. Everyone stay where you are; no one should leave their place on the seventh day.’ 🕊️
So the people rested on the seventh day. 🛌
Israel’s people named the bread ‘manna.’ It looked like white coriander seed and tasted like wafers with honey. 🍯
Moses said, ‘Yahweh commanded: “Keep one full omer of this bread through every generation, so they can see the bread I fed you with in the wilderness after bringing you out of Egypt.”’ 🫙
Moses told Aaron, ‘Take a jar, put a full omer of manna in it, and keep it before Yahweh through every generation.’ 🫙
Aaron stored it before the Testimony, just as Yahweh commanded Moses, so it could be kept. 📜
Israel’s people ate manna for forty years, until they reached settled land. They ate it until they reached Canaan’s border. ⏳
An omer is one-tenth of an ephah. 📏
